release_notes: A hotfix round for operator notifications. The push sender is now loaded on every path: "Send test" stopped returning a 500 and — more importantly — conversion pushes no longer fail silently from the postback path (before, only the digest cron could send). On macOS a repeated notification tag arrived as a silent Notification Center update with no banner; the service worker now retires the previous same-tag notification first, and every test push carries its own tag. The mobile burger menu opens with an account block (user, Notifications, Profile, Install when offered), so an installed narrow panel can reach everything without the desktop-only avatar menu; the navbar also lost its duplicate gear-menu Notifications entry and its top-bar Install pill. API-key callers (MCP, scripts, integrations) now read settings with every secret masked — posting a masked value back never overwrites the real one.
